models.vlm: Qwen/Qwen3.5-27B served locally with vLLM; recorded revision was unspecified

shared_conditions.controller: LIBERO OSC_POSE at 20 Hz, normalized XYZ + axis-angle + gripper

hybrid_contract.planner: Qwen returns semantic pixel/keyframe proposals only
hybrid_contract.geometry: task-blind RGB-D region inventory, calibrated deprojection and staged XYZ contact/transport/release
hybrid_contract.reference_memory: public static LIBERO asset texture used only for appearance matching; it supplies no scene pose, segmentation or success state
hybrid_contract.jev: selects one executable Hx7 action chunk from state-dependent numeric candidates
hybrid_contract.locking: contact phases and destination geometry are locked to prevent unsafe mid-contact replanning

scheduling.vlm-chunk-no-jev: cached semantic proposal; deterministic nominal candidate
scheduling.vlm-jev-triggered: cached semantic proposal; Qwen refreshes on stage/uncertainty/stagnation triggers; Jev judges local candidates
scheduling.vlm-jev-dense: fresh Qwen proposal before every non-atomic source-stage Jev judgment; atomic contact and transport remain locked

limitations: Only two fixed development initial states were evaluated.
This is not a LIBERO leaderboard or cross-scene generalization result.
The VLM server revision field was not pinned in the captured protocol.
Only Jev provider cost is known; local GPU amortization is not priced.
